description:
🚀 Team Stellaris is a group of passionate innovators interested in space science, astronomy, AI/ML, web development, and Earth observation. We're building impactful solutions through creativity, research, and collaboration. We welcome enthusiastic participants skilled in GIS, remote sensing, SAR imagery, Python, AI/ML, data science, and 3D visualization. Let's explore beyond boundaries and turn ideas into reality!

✨ Exploring Earth, Empowering Tomorrow.
